title: Retinoic acid and sperm production in infertile men
official: Retinoic acid and sperm production in infertile men
summary: Main objective: To evaluate, in terms of sperm production, the effectiveness of treatment with isotretinoin in patients with oligozoospermia.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male aged between 21 and 55 years (inclusive)
2. Diagnosed with oligozoospermia [fewer than 15 million spermatozoa per ml, fewer than 39 million per ejaculate], confirmed by two separate semen analyses performed at least one month apart and conducted prior to the inclusion visit (within the 12 months preceding inclusion), as part of routine care
3. Infertility lasting more than 12 months
4. Patient affiliated with or benefiting from a health insurance scheme
5. Patient able to understand the objectives and risks of the study and provide dated and signed informed consent
6. Patient informed of the results of the preliminary medical examination
Exclusion criteria:
1. Known genetic cause of infertility (e.g., chromosomal abnormalities)
2. Current treatment with vitamin A
3. Known hepatic insufficiency, defined by ASAT/ALAT >2x upper limit of normal at the inclusion visit
4. Known severe renal insufficiency, defined by albuminuria and/or abnormal blood creatinine levels at the inclusion visit
5. History of severe allergic or anaphylactic reactions
6. Known psychiatric disorder (e.g., depression, psychotic symptoms, mood changes), defined by an MDI score >15 at inclusion
7. Known history of suicide attempts or known suicide risk
8. Surgery of the genitourinary tract in the year preceding inclusion
9. Prior treatment with isotretinoin (e.g., Acnetrait, Contracné, Curacné, Procuta) within the 3 months prior to the inclusion visit
10. Tobacco use (more than 5 cigarettes per day)
11. Chronic alcohol consumption
12. Patient with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism
13. Use of systemic medication within the 3 months prior to inclusion
14. Patient informed of and consenting not to donate blood during treatment and for 1 month after its completion
15. Patient currently in an exclusion period (as determined by a previous or ongoing study)
16. Patient under legal guardianship or curatorship
17. Patient under judicial protection
18. Inability to provide informed consent (e.g., emergency situations, comprehension difficulties, language barriers, etc.)
19. Any other clinically significant comorbid condition interfering with spermatogenesis
20. Hypersensitivity to isotretinoin or any of its excipients
21. Known hyperlipidemia defined by elevated triglycerides >1 g/L
22. Known hypervitaminosis A defined by levels >800 µg
23. Known allergy to peanut oil, soybean oil, or magnesium stearate
24. Ongoing treatment with other retinoids (e.g., acitretin, alitretinoin)
25. Ongoing treatment interfering with spermatogenesis and/or vitamin A metabolism (e.g., tetracyclines, rifampicin, phenytoin, phenobarbital, antiretrovirals, or other CYP enzyme inducers)
